6.en:
Brief — last 6 hours

  • Active strikes / explosions
    • IDF & ISA reported strike on a senior Hamas military figure. Israeli posts say a senior commander in Hamas' military wing was struck; Gaza sources name Samir Abu Yunis (Abu Mohammad) killed in a UAV strike on a tent in Al‑Mawasi, Khan Younis. Separate IDF drone strike in northern Gaza reported two killed.
    • Explosions along Iran’s southern coast. Reports of explosions in Kang, Qeshm Island, Bandar Lengeh and Bandar Kangan. IRGC Navy says two tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

  • Intelligence

    • Mossad reportedly passed intelligence to the CIA alleging an Iranian plot to assassinate President Trump and senior U.S. officials using explosive drones. U.S. sources reported the CIA verified that intelligence.

  • Iraq & Yemen

    • An attack targeted the Khor Mor oil & gas field in Sulaymaniyah governorate (northern Iraq).
    • Reports that Ansarallah (Houthis) captured Jabal Al‑Kherz and Kherz Camp and encircled a large area of PLC‑controlled southern Yemeni coast. Separate reports claim Saudi warplanes carried out 72 airstrikes across Yemen in the past 24 hours.

  • Political

    • Al Jazeera: Israeli government vows an "offensive policy" in Gaza despite caretaker status.
    • Netanyahu: only a unity government can guarantee Israel’s security.

  • Other

    • Iranian state media item reported changes to the Kharmashahr missile warhead weight could enable use against U.S. bases in Europe (reported on Iranian TV).

  • Bottom line

    • Threat trend: Increased regional kinetic activity and reported targeted assassination plotting in the last six hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF/ISA report a successful strike on a senior Hamas military target; CIA–Mossad intelligence sharing reported.
6.he:
עדכון — שעתיים אחרונות

  • תקיפות / התפוצצויות פעילות
    • צה"ל ושב"כ דיווחו על תקיפה של בכיר בזרוע הצבאית של חמאס. פרסומים ישראליים דיווחו על תקיפת בכיר; מקורות בעזה מזכירים את שמיר אבו יונס (אבו מוחמד) כחוסל בתקיפת כט"ב על אוהל במואאסי, ח'אן יונס. תקיפת כט"ב בנגב הצפוני דווחה כגבתה שני הרוגים.
    • התפוצצויות בחופי דרום איראן. דווחים על רעשים/פיצוצים בקאנג, באי קֶשם, בנדר לנגה ובנדר קאנגאן. חילות הים של משמרות המהפכה דיווחו ששני מכליות דלק עלו באש לאחר שנפגעו במוקשים במצר הורמוז.

  • מודיעין

    • דיווח כי המוסד העביר ל‑CIA מודיעין על מזימה איראנית לחיסול הנשיא טראמפ ובכירים אמריקאים בעזרת כטמ"מ פיצוץ. דווח כי ה‑CIA אימת את המידע.

  • עיראק ותימן

    • דווח על תקיפה ששמה כוונה לשדה הגז והנפט קור מור בסולימאניה (צפון עיראק).
    • דו"חות מצביעים על כיבוש ג'בל אל‑חֶרז ומחנה חֶרז על ידי אנצאראללה והקפת שטח חוף דרומי בשליטה PLC. דו"ח נפרד טוען כי מטוסי הסעודים ביצעו 72 תקיפות אוויריות בתימן ב‑24 השעות האחרונות.

  • פוליטיקה

    • אל-ג'זירה: הממשלה הכריזה על מדיניות "התקפית" בעזה למרות מעמד ראשי הממשלה המטפל.
    • נתניהו: רק ממשלת אחדות תבטיח את ביטחונה של ישראל.

  • שורה תחתונה

    • מגמת איום: עלייה בפעילות קינטית אזורית ובדיווחים על מזימת חיסול ב‑6 שעות האחרונות.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: צה"ל/שב"כ מדווחים על תקיפה מוצלחת של מפקד חמאס; דווח על שיתוף מודיעין מאומת בין מוסד ל‑CIA.

24.en:
Situation Report — last 24h

  • Strikes / explosions (highest priority)
  • IDF/ISA strike: Israeli military and ISA announced a strike on a senior Hamas military figure. Gaza sources report Samir Abu Younes (Abu Muhammad), Rafah brigade commander, was killed by an Israeli UAV/rocket strike near Khan Younis. Two reported killed in northern Gaza in a separate drone strike.
  • Iranian coast / Strait of Hormuz: Explosions heard/reported in Bandar Kong, Bandar Lengeh, Kang and Qeshm Island. Some outlets suggested possible U.S. strikes. IRGC Navy said two oil tankers struck naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire; IRGC claims the vessels were on an unauthorized route with AIS disabled.
  • Intelligence: Israeli press reports Mossad passed intelligence to the CIA alleging an Iranian plot to assassinate President Trump and senior U.S. officials using explosive drones. The CIA reportedly verified the intelligence.
  • Other fronts: An attack targeted Khor Mor oil & gas field in Sulaymaniyah (Iraq). Houthi forces reported new territorial gains on Yemen’s southern coast.
  • Politics: Israel vows a continued Gaza 'offensive policy' despite caretaker government status. Netanyahu said only a unity government can guarantee security.
  • Threat trend: Escalating — multiple strikes and explosions across Gaza, Iran’s coast/Strait of Hormuz, and Iraq within 24 hours.
  • 🟢 Good News: Israeli and U.S. intelligence agencies reportedly coordinated; CIA verification indicates shared actionable intel. Israeli forces report a successful strike on a senior Hamas commander.

48.en:
Situation report — last 48 hours

  • Active strikes/explosions: IDF and ISA struck and reportedly killed a senior Hamas military commander (Palestinian sources name Samir Abu Younis, Rafah brigade). Explosions were heard across southern Iran (Kang, Qeshm Island, Bandar Lengeh/Kangan).
  • Maritime/Hormuz: IRGC Navy says two oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz. IRGC alleges the tankers used an unauthorized route and had AIS/navigation disabled.
  • Intelligence — assassination plot: Israeli press says Mossad passed intelligence to the CIA alleging an Iranian plot to assassinate President Trump and senior US officials using explosive drones. Reports state the CIA verified that intelligence.
  • Iraq: An attack targeted the Khor Mor oil & gas field in Sulaymaniyah governorate (northern Iraq).
  • Yemen/Houthi advances: Ansarallah (Houthis) reportedly captured Jabal al-Kherz and Kherz Camp, operationally encircling a large area of PLC-controlled southern coastal territory.
  • Israel domestic/political: Netanyahu said only a unity government can guarantee Israel’s security. Al Jazeera reports Israel vows a Gaza “offensive policy” despite caretaker status.
  • Iranian military messaging: Iranian state media reported changes to the Khorramshahr missile’s warhead weight to enable use against US bases in Europe.
  • Sources reporting protective measures: Reports indicate President Trump reduced public appearances and senior US officials were moved to secure facilities.
  • Threat trend: Escalating regionally — simultaneous strikes/explosions, maritime incidents, and intelligence of an assassination plot indicate rising tensions across multiple fronts.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF/ISA strike reportedly eliminated a senior Hamas field commander. Mossad–CIA intelligence sharing reportedly verified.
